## Verdict
REVISE — Clarify the read-only boundary, conflicting policy ownership, and daily suspend/resume behavior.

## Critical gaps
- **Some “status” operations write:** `android/reading-mode.sh:242–245` modifies filesystem state when a snapshot exists. Specify a nonmutating diagnostic allowlist; candidate benchmarks, shutdown, resets, and setting changes remain future, separately authorized work.
- **Journaling alone does not resolve competing writers.** Reading Mode restores settings unconditionally; idle saver also controls Battery Saver and discards ownership markers on startup. Define legacy-service handoff, serialization, manual-override precedence, and crash/reboot recovery. Treat Termux’s wakelock as potentially shared with other Termux work, not SSH-exclusive.

## Important improvements
- Model activity—reading, screen-off standby, explicit storage shutdown—separately from connectivity. Passive screen-on reading must not become “idle” merely through lack of input. Doze is not proof of CPU suspend.
- Correct the source assessment: idle saver already excludes charging, HDMI, established SSH, and connected ADB (`service.sh:129`). It also mixes Android user-activity uptime with suspend-inclusive `/proc/uptime` (`:54–59`), potentially misclassifying inactivity after suspend. Polling intervals alone do not establish suspend wakeup frequency.
- Specify backend lifecycle feasibility: event delivery during suspend, process death/reboot reconciliation, and explicit unsupported/degraded behavior without sufficient privileges. Match specialization to the actual LineageOS/kernel build; Xiaomi stock-ROM guidance is not automatically applicable.

## Validation gaps
- Define future benchmark controls: readable matched luminance, verified refresh mode, reader workload, temperature/SOC, repeated sufficiently long unplugged standby windows, and measurement resolution. Exclude SSH/ADB observers during measured windows; check actual su...
